pass_rule: PASS requires every applicable mandatory observable obligation established from actual command-level evidence; otherwise PARTIAL/NOT_VERIFIED/BLOCKED; no automatic product acceptance
scope: Single bounded HUA local read-only preflight

verification_obligations.G03-VC-01: Effective TaskContract, registered identity, human scope and dispatch exist before ANY command.
verification_obligations.G03-VC-02: HUA host and Codex Desktop capability attested from authorized surface (or NOT_VERIFIED).
verification_obligations.G03-VC-03: Each of exactly two candidate roots has explicit exists/not exists/inaccessible result without recursive scan.
verification_obligations.G03-VC-04: For accessible verified Git roots, canonical root, HEAD, branch and origin/main tracking SHA captured.
verification_obligations.G03-VC-05: Git status -porcelain=v1 -uall and worktree list observed without unauthorized Git writes.
verification_obligations.G03-VC-06: Owner/concurrency/dirty attribution attested from existing approved metadata or marked NOT_VERIFIED.
verification_obligations.G03-VC-07: Each actually invoked command has exact command, stdout/stderr, exit, timestamp/order; refusal unchanged.
verification_obligations.G03-VC-08: START/END comparison and zero-mutation evidence are adequate or explicitly NOT_VERIFIED.
verification_obligations.G03-VC-09: Old HRR stays blocked; no retry of denied command, no old budget consumed, no unauthorized scope.
verification_obligations.G03-VC-10: Structured return includes budget consumption/pending and STOP/unknowns, no invented PASS.
